CustomField.description: As a sales rep, I want to know the time it took from when a quote was sent to the customer to when the quote was mark as Closed - Won so I can track this metric.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays the difference in minutes between Initial Quote Sent Date and when the Opportunity has reached the "Closed - Won" stage. This only takes business days into account.
CustomField.label: Quote to Order Time
